propositions: The divergent_implementation axis is mis-calibrated: it fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings (the only hard-override axis never calibrated with worked examples), and scores the entire omitted-scope class (~1,307 findings) as none ~90% of the time, leaving real divergence-class defects unblocked.

The axis must be split from ordinal none|low|medium|high into a closed Literal with four grades: contradicts_reality and omits_required_site (both floor at 0.85), incomplete_enumeration (contributes below all thresholds, no floor), and none; this requires structural separation from _SEV01 via DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 and _DIVERGENCE_FLOOR_GRADES so the axis stops mis-scoring.

A high-cost LLM-based calibration strategy (purpose-built eval suites, bulk re-review runs) is rejected via ADR 0054 in favor of zero-marginal-cost methods: offline corpus replay and field dogfooding; ADR 0036's permissive-rollout and version-segmentation rules remain unchanged.

The target defect (G6 finding c4ad-a93e-0613-408f, omitting four s3vectors sites from plan scope) must now block via omits_required_site grade because it belonged to the ~1,173-finding unblocked omitted-scope class; current plan-v3 impact is 0.0 and decision is ADVISORY despite validity=0.8889 and block_threshold=0.60.

A proposed prod_impact floor fix is rejected as structurally colliding with the novelty convergence floor (novelty_priority_floor=0.4): Fix 2 would lift 545–735 findings across 0.4 based on an axis orthogonal to remediability, risking non-terminating remediation loops, while Fix 1 lifts only 357 (bounded, semantically remediable class).

Three rounds of the gate reviewing its own plan found real gaps (missing _SEV01 exclusion, unenumerated test fixtures outside tests/unit, verifier preamble fighting new grades) and two new real divergence cases (G7.md ordinal grades, stale fixture references); the pattern confirms the change is material and self-correcting calibration feedback.
